topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Finding the stack of papers hidden between old journals and forgotten letters, I noticed the familiar handwriting that wasn’t mine. Each page was filled with scenes that felt as real as the moments we had shared, yet woven with threads of fiction that painted our life in a new, compelling light. I couldn’t stop turning the pages, each word drawing me deeper into a story that was both ours and not ours. The apartment around me faded away, leaving only the glow of the setting sun and the warmth of his words. It was more than a surprise; it was a revelation, a fresh lens through which I could see the beauty of our journey together.
